info.name: SnpDepotManagement - Week 4
info.description: Local test data only. Run folders in order. Every run creates a unique suffix; shared catalog writes require Admin. Never export real passwords/tokens. Collection format v2.1 for file-based portability.

item.name: Initialize a unique test run - Liveness

exec: if (!pm.environment.get('adminPassword') || !pm.environment.get('testUserPassword')) throw new Error('Fill adminPassword and testUserPassword in your LOCAL environment first');
for (const role of ['yard','order','gate']) pm.environment.set(role + 'UserName', role + suffix);

pm.environment.set('adminAccessToken', data.accessToken); pm.environment.set('adminRefreshToken', data.refreshToken); pm.test('tokens received', () => { pm.expect(data.accessToken).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(data.refreshToken).to.be.a('string'); });

item.name: Get layout and save ground slots

exec: pm.test('40ft uses logical even bays', () => { pm.expect(data.totalCount).to.eql(3); pm.expect(data.items).to.have.length(2); data.items.forEach(s=>pm.expect(s.bay%2).to.eql(0)); });

pm.environment.set('yardAccessToken', data.accessToken); pm.environment.set('yardRefreshToken', data.refreshToken); pm.test('tokens received', () => { pm.expect(data.accessToken).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(data.refreshToken).to.be.a('string'); });

pm.environment.set('orderAccessToken', data.accessToken); pm.environment.set('orderRefreshToken', data.refreshToken); pm.test('tokens received', () => { pm.expect(data.accessToken).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(data.refreshToken).to.be.a('string'); });

pm.environment.set('gateAccessToken', data.accessToken); pm.environment.set('gateRefreshToken', data.refreshToken); pm.test('tokens received', () => { pm.expect(data.accessToken).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(data.refreshToken).to.be.a('string'); });
